title: 8x8 Procedural Images: Two Photometric Intensity Levels (Residual-Upsample Width-16)
intuition: Architectural transfer variant of `img_intensity2` replacing transposed convolutions with nearest-neighbor upsampling + width-16 residual Conv2d blocks. Tests photometric amplitude fidelity rather than spatial position: a centered 4x4 square must be generated at both target brightnesses (0.35 and 0.85) with tight template RMSE (<= 0.06).
failure_mode: Trainers collapse to a single intermediate gray level (~0.60) or drop the dimmer/brighter mode entirely.
protocol_notes: Separate residual-upsample image architecture cohort of `img_intensity2`.
